summary: Named only on a Georgia lookout tower list (Clay County, map dated 2016); no source found gives its build, design, fate or what remains today.

evidence.supports: List entry: Perkins Lookout Tower, Clay County, coordinates, elevation 505
The list is titled Georgia lookout towers
The list's columns are lat/lon, elevation and GFC number
evidence.quote: GA tower list lat/lon, elevation, GFC number

evidence.supports: Separate Clay Lookout Tower in Clay County at 31.60156, -84.96881
The page's map was revised on 22 March 2016

notes_for_editor: Only source is the tnlandforms.us Georgia list (one page). The list gives the elevation 505 with no unit, so the story says so rather than converting it. Two WebSearch calls turned up the Perkins Memorial Tower at Bear Mountain, New York (search snippets only, not read). It is a different tower and is not used; a reviewer should keep it apart from this record. The Georgia Forestry Commission history page linked from the list timed out, and the savannahnow.com 2006 article returned 403, so neither was read. The story is short because the list gives no build, design, fate or access.
